mapper.select: select count(1) count, min(wr.id) min_id, max(wr.id) max_id from ods_withdraw_record wr where wr.updated >= CONCAT(#{dateStr}, ' 00:00:00') and wr.updated < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{dateStr}, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

select duwr.id, wr.dates, wr.id source_id, wr.project_name, wr.user_id, wr.withdraw_type, wr.status, IFNULL(oprw.amount, IFNULL(wr.amount, 0)) amount, IFNULL(IFNULL(oprw.fee, IFNULL(wr.fee, 0)), 0) fee, #{singleFee} `exchange_rate`, ROUND(IFNULL(oprw.amount, IFNULL(wr.amount, 0)) / #{singleFee}, 8) `change_amount`, ROUND(IFNULL(IFNULL(oprw.fee, IFNULL(wr.fee, 0)), 0) / #{singleFee}, 8) `change_fee`, ROUND((IFNULL(IFNULL(oprw.fee, IFNULL(wr.fee, 0)), 0) + IFNULL(oprw.amount, IFNULL(wr.amount, 0))) / #{singleFee}, 8) change_total_amount, wr.num, uv.max_pvn version, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, uv.pvn register_version, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, wr.created) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, wr.dates) register_day, wr.created create_time, DATE_FORMAT(wr.updated, '%Y%m%d') update_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, wr.updated) register_withdraw_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, wr.updated) register_withdraw_day, wr.updated update_time from ods_withdraw_record wr INNER JOIN ods_user u on (wr.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, MIN(uv.pvn) pvn, max(uv.pvn) max_pvn FROM ods_user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv on (uv.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_pay_record_withdraw oprw on (oprw.withdraw_record_id = wr.id and oprw.status = 1) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_withdraw_record duwr on (duwr.source_id = wr.id) where wr.updated >= CONCAT(#{dateStr}, ' 00:00:00') and wr.updated < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{dateStr}, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and wr.id >= #{startId} and wr.id <= #{endId}

SELECT duwr.id, duwr.update_dates dates, duwr.source_id, duwr.project_name, duwr.user_id, duwr.withdraw_type, duwr.amount, duwr.fee, duwr.exchange_rate, duwr.change_amount, duwr.change_fee, duwr.change_total_amount, duwr.status, duwr.version, duwr.pkg, duwr.country, duwr.register_date, duwr.register_dates, duwr.register_version, duwr.register_day, duwr.register_cohort_day, duwr.create_time, duwr.update_dates, duwr.register_withdraw_day, duwr.register_withdraw_cohort_day, duwr.update_time, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source FROM dwd_user_withdraw_record duwr left join dim_user_source dus on (duwr.user_id = dus.user_id) WHERE duwr.update_dates = #{dates} and duwr.id >= #{startId} and duwr.id < #{endId}
